entries.title: Your phone keeps working when your computer updates first
entries.body: Infinitary on your phone, or on another computer that controls this one, now keeps answering cards, sending messages and controlling tasks when your computer runs a newer Infinitary, as long as nothing the two share has changed. When one of them does need an update, the line under the message box says which: this phone or your computer.
entries.noPicture: The desktop app's screens look the same; the change is which versions work together and the phone's one line naming the side to update.
